title: VahanHelp
summary: A digital automotive service platform that makes challan payments, RC transfer and RTO services simple, fast and transparent.
challenge: Vehicle documentation and RTO processes are slow and confusing for most vehicle owners — from checking and paying traffic challans to transferring an RC — with little clarity on what each service involves or costs.
solution: We built a fast, user-friendly platform that brings vehicle services, challan checking and payment, Parivahan Mitra services and RTO assistance together in one place, with transparent service information, online payments and quick support via WhatsApp.

title: Pink Vila
summary: A modern, responsive website for a family restaurant in Jaunpur — menu, ambience, reviews and table reservations in one place.
challenge: Pink Vila needed an online home that captures its signature pink-themed ambience and lets customers explore the full menu, find the restaurant and book a table without having to call first.
solution: We designed and built an elegant, mobile-responsive website with a complete digital menu, featured dishes, a food and ambience gallery, customer reviews, Google Maps directions, one-tap call and WhatsApp, and a table reservation request flow.
features: Complete digital menu with categories & prices

title: The Olive Table
summary: A modern, elegant restaurant website with a premium sage-green and cream aesthetic — menu, gallery, reviews and table reservations in one place.
challenge: The Olive Table needed an online presence that matches its calm, refined dining experience — one that lets guests explore the menu, see the food and interiors, and request a table easily from any device.
solution: We designed and developed a modern, elegant restaurant website with a premium sage-green and cream aesthetic. It features an interactive digital menu, a food and interior gallery, customer reviews, restaurant information and table reservation requests — built with a focus on responsive design, intuitive navigation and a seamless experience across desktop and mobile.

title: Veloura
summary: A premium fashion e-commerce website delivering an elegant, seamless online shopping experience for a modern luxury brand.
challenge: A modern luxury fashion brand needed a digital storefront that feels as refined as its collections — presenting products with sophistication while keeping shopping simple and seamless.
solution: We designed and developed Veloura, a premium fashion e-commerce website with curated collections of menswear, womenswear and accessories. Minimalist aesthetics meet sophisticated product presentation, with best-selling products, a brand story section, newsletter subscriptions, and dedicated shopping and customer support pages.
